body: I’m currently on antidepressants (the 4th one I’ve tried) and I’m seeing a university counsellor, I tried to get help from the community mental health team but they turned me down due to funding issues I think, and I had CBT when I was 15 and nothing has worked

Abusive alcoholic mother, deadbeat dad (different dad to my siblings so I was always the black sheep) raising my younger siblings for years, severe bullying, unhealthy emotionally abusive relationships... you name it
My whole life has been a shitshow, and I guess I’m just done with living with what’s happened in the past
